homicideRate.basis: Sonora: 1,634 deaths registered as presumed homicides in 2025 per 3,041,340 residents (INEGI, Defunciones por homicidio, comunicado 42/26, tables 1 and 2; preliminary).
homicideRate.limitations: A state rate for Sonora, by state of registration; INEGI's release does not give Hermosillo separately, and 2025 figures are preliminary.

eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Hermosillo Observatorio, climate normals 1981-2010.
coldestMonthMean.limitations: Wikipedia's table is captioned 1991–2020, but its source note gives 1981–2010 for temperatures; the older period is used.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Hermosillo Observatorio, climate normals 1981-2010.
warmestMonthMeanMax.limitations: Wikipedia's table is captioned 1991–2020, but its source note gives 1981–2010 for temperatures; the older period is used.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 29.07°, calculated.

cityWide.basis: MXN 182.00 per m² in the whole city (midpoint of centre and elsewhere) × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom. Built from published listing averages, converted at 18.48 pesos per dollar (the app's ECB rates): livingcost.org (June 2026) gives US$564 for a 40 m² one-bedroom flat in the centre and US$287 for a cheap one, US$999 and US$525 for 80 m² three-bedroom flats; Expatistan (October 2026) gives 18,080 and 10,080 pesos for a furnished 85 m² flat in an expensive and a normal area, and 6,310 pesos for a 45 m² studio in a normal area; Nomad List gives US$518 for a one-bedroom flat in the centre. Per m²: centre about 213 to 261 pesos (mean 235), elsewhere 119 to 140 (mean 128); the city-wide figure is the midpoint of the two.
cityWide.limitations: An unverified estimate from crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites, which say their Hermosillo data is thin; not an official rent statistic. To be checked against listings or a market report before 1.0.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 19.08 MXN for each euro spent in Finland.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 12.10 MXN for each euro spent in Finland.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 14.50 MXN for each euro spent in Finland.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 14.57 MXN for each euro spent in Finland.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 14.13 MXN for each euro spent in Finland.

1.basis: Electricity (with air conditioning), water and gas, from published averages: Expatistan gives 1,771 pesos a month for two people in an 85 m² flat (about 21 per m²) and 951 pesos for one person in a 45 m² studio (about 21 per m²); livingcost.org gives US$71.50 (about 1,320 pesos) for one person, about 29 per m² in a 45 m² flat. 21 per m² a month × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
1.limitations: An unverified estimate from crowd-sourced averages over the year; summer bills with air conditioning are much higher and winter ones lower. Hermosillo's summer electricity tariff (1F) is subsidised up to a consumption limit. To be checked against CFE tariffs before 1.0.

transitPassAdult.basis: Urban bus fare of 9 pesos (kept by Sonora's transport institute in August 2025) for 44 rides a month; 60 rides for the range. There is no monthly pass.
transitPassAdult.limitations: Assumes two rides a working day.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Out-of-pocket health spending per person in Mexico (US$313.80 in 2023, World Bank) at the 2023 average exchange rate (17.74 pesos per dollar).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average. Salaried workers are covered by IMSS, but many people also pay for private care.

carMonthly.basis: El Imparcial (9 October 2026): a financed compact car of 300,000 pesos costs 8,600 to 10,800 pesos a month: a 5,710-peso loan payment, 1,500 to 2,500 for petrol, 800 to 1,500 for comprehensive insurance, 400 to 700 for maintenance and 200 to 400 for state fees.
carMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim. The loan payment stands in for the cost of owning the car (it includes repaying it, not depreciation); parking, tolls and repairs are not included. To be checked before 1.0.

carRunningMonthly.basis: What remains once the car is paid for: petrol, insurance, maintenance and state fees, 2,900 to 5,100 pesos a month in El Imparcial's example.
carRunningMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim. The loan payment stands in for the cost of owning the car (it includes repaying it, not depreciation); parking, tolls and repairs are not included. To be checked before 1.0.
